description: Location de vélos CyCLO Bruxelles is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CyCLO. Contains information on bicycle rentals by CyCLO in Brussels. Coverage: CyCLO. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle rental CyCLO Brussels" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CyCLO. The listing shows 1 download or service links in MSG_HTTP. The listing shows 2024-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.be/.well-known/genid/63236b7128d642e2a86d55d8b03caaf55-4F0950288003A114B44F086155D85AA8). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
